name: MMBench-V1.1
intro: MMBench-V1.1 是 Qwen3-VL、Qwen2.5-Omni 等报告使用的 MMBench 版本，用于通用视觉问答能力评测。
build_method: MMBench版本化评测, 混合构建
eval_feature: CircularEval, 选项抽取, 视觉问答
intro_en: MMBench-V1.1 is a MMBench version used by reports such as Qwen3-VL and Qwen2.5-Omni for general visual question-answering evaluation.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Use the official MMBench item pool and evaluation framework as the source"] --> B["Select the MMBench-V1.1 version referenced by model reports"]
    B --> C["Evaluate on the corresponding development or test split"]
    C --> D["Build image multiple-choice prompts with hints and options"]
    D --> E["Apply CircularEval to reduce option-order sensitivity"]
    E --> F["Extract the predicted option from free-form model responses"]
    F --> G["Aggregate predictions in the reporting or VLMEvalKit pipeline"]
    G --> H["Report MMBench-V1.1 accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["以官方MMBench题池和评测框架为来源"] --> B["选择模型报告中引用的MMBench-V1.1版本"]
    B --> C["在对应开发集或测试集上评估"]
    C --> D["构建包含图像、提示和候选项的多选题提示"]
    D --> E["执行CircularEval以降低选项顺序敏感性"]
    E --> F["从模型自由回复中抽取预测选项"]
    F --> G["在报告或VLMEvalKit流程中汇总预测"]
    G --> H["报告MMBench-V1.1准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MMBench paper arXiv:2307.06281 and OpenCompass/VLMEvalKit usage. No separate MMBench-V1.1 paper is recorded in the current site data, so the diagram uses the official MMBench construction and evaluation contract: image multiple-choice questions, fine-grained ability taxonomy, dev/test splits, CircularEval, choice extraction from free-form outputs, and accuracy reporting for the version used by model reports.
